explication: This repository documents an incremental effort to build a self-hosting compiler for a subset of C. The principal workflow takes C source through scanning, parsing and semantic handling to generated code, then—depending on the version and options—through assembly and linking. The README also documents language-feature branches including preprocessing, types, control flow, initialization and optimization. The tree shows many successive implementations; detailed wiring is only confirmed for the sampled top-level driver, so internal compiler-stage links are intentionally limited. Earlier ARM and later QBE backends are documented capabilities, not evidence that every version uses them.
